verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official SDK, but it is narrowly scoped to IaC custom rules. It covers installing the SDK, writing rules in Rego, parsing input files, unit-testing rules, and bundling and pushing them to OCI registries for use by the Snyk IaC CLI. There is no evidence of general-purpose language SDKs or client libraries for building applications or agents against the Snyk platform, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: official language SDKs or client libraries for the Snyk API, SDK coverage beyond IaC custom rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
